integrity: Analytic proofs and a standalone exact-rational checker are included; the checker does not replace an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves cubic/quintic all-size spectra and the all-degree n=5 resonance law; it does not classify higher-degree resonances for all n. An equivalent earlier Johnson-scheme treatment is a residual originality risk. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Cubic and quintic orthogonality resonances for regular simplex edge harmonics
